venue.name: Heather Goldminc Clayworks Studio
venue.description: Clayworks Studio is the Lantzville clay studio of Heather Goldminc, who has designed ceramics for Blue Sky Clayworks for 25 years and makes one of a kind pieces of her own. The website is mostly an online shop for those pieces, with a studio at 7060 Arbutus Cres that is open Monday to Saturday. A short workshops page says the studio runs different workshops through the year, from building and glazing ceramic pieces to making jewellery with beads made in the studio, and asks you to get in touch to find out what is currently on. The site says nothing about children, school groups or daycare groups.
venue.hours_notes: Studio hours Monday to Friday 10am to 5pm, Saturday 11am to 5pm.

programs.name: Ceramics workshop
programs.description: The workshops page says the studio runs many different workshops through the year, from building and glazing ceramic pieces to jewellery making with beads made in the studio. It gives no dates, no prices and no ages, and asks you to contact the studio to find out what is being offered at the moment.
programs.our_note: The studio has a shop front and set opening hours, but the workshops page carries no dates, no prices and no ages at all. If you want a session for a group of children, phone first and ask whether she runs one, what age she will take and how many people fit in the studio.
programs.practical_summary: Nothing is published about washrooms, lunch space, parking or how big a group the studio can hold. All of it has to be asked on the phone.
programs.evidence: We offer many different workshops throughout the year. From building and glazing ceramic pieces to jewelry making with our own studio made beads.

images.alt: A woman holding a large black ceramic house decorated with pumpkins, standing in front of glass shelves filled with small ceramic figures.

gaps: Price: nothing published. The workshops page gives no cost of any kind.
Youngest age: nothing published. The site never says whether children can take part in a workshop, so we have not answered whether school or daycare groups are hosted.
Capacity: nothing published. The studio is a small shop on a residential street and no group size is given.
Lead time: nothing published. The workshops page only says to contact the studio to learn what is currently being offered.
Washrooms, lunch space, rain backup, parking and accessibility: nothing published anywhere on the site.
Workshop dates and subjects: the page says workshops run throughout the year but lists none, so we could not record months or days.

The site is an online shop and its only social image is the studio wordmark, so the hero photo is the picture at the top of the home page. It was opened in a browser and looked at before its description was written, because the site gives it no alt text of its own.
The site publishes no email address, only a contact form and a phone number.
The tracker calls this venue Clayworks Studio/Gallery. The site calls itself Heather Goldminc Clayworks Studio and does not use the word gallery.
